name: Лежит на животе
description: Универсальная композиция лёжа на животе с вариативным положением корпуса, рук, ног и направлением взгляда.

layouts.name: Оглядывается через плечо
required: lying comfortably on the stomach on a horizontal surface
upper body supported naturally by the forearms or elbows
pelvis resting on the supporting surface
head turned back over one shoulder toward the camera

torso.text: upper body raised slightly from the surface
chest resting closer to the supporting surface

legs.text: legs extended naturally behind the body
one knee bent slightly while the other remains extended
feet resting naturally with relaxed ankles

arms.text: body supported evenly on both forearms
more weight resting on one forearm
one hand resting lightly beneath the upper body

head.text: looking back over one shoulder toward the camera
head turned back with a slight downward tilt
head turned back with a gentle sideways tilt

layouts.name: Руки заведены назад
required: lying on the stomach on a horizontal surface
both arms reaching backward along the sides of the body
the anus and vagina are visible

torso.text: upper body resting naturally on the supporting surface
chest raised slightly from the supporting surface

arms.text: hands resting on the outer hips
hands resting on the upper thighs
hands placed symmetrically along the sides of the pelvis

legs.text: legs extended comfortably with knees close together
feet resting naturally with relaxed ankles

head.text: head turned back over one shoulder
head turned slightly to one side

camera.text: rear view aligned with the body axis
